description: This file defines a template function 'collapse_dims' in the 'at' namespace, which updates sizes and strides to reflect a collapse operation on tensor dimensions. It handles optional exclusion of a dimension and returns a pair indicating the remapped excluded dimension and the new number of dimensions.

methods.name: std::pair<int64_t,int64_t> collapse_dims(T * sizes,T * strides,int64_t dims,const int excludeDim=-1)
methods.description: A template function that collapses dimensions of tensors by updating sizes and strides, optionally excluding a specific dimension, and returns remapped dimension index and new dimension count.
